newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO RUBBER ENDS LOWER ON POSITION SQUARING.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO RUBBER ENDS LOWER ON POSITION SQUARING.

text.p: All Tokyo rubber futures closed lower on Wednesday, as position squaring in spot August weighed down the market throughout the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 to 2.5 yen lower, with benchmark January 1998 ending down 1.8 yen at 119.3 yen per kg.
Selling orders from local investors capped the topside from the opening, particularly in nearby months, traders said.

Spot August expires on August 25. Traders said position squaring in the spot contract will pressure the market until the end of next week. "We're watching to see if the spot falls below 100 yen," a trader said.-- Tokyo Commodities Desk
